parsed.rationale: The second participating record, `MockNotificationMessage` in `Shared/Core/Sources/CoreTesting/_Plant_MockNotificationMessage.swift`, carries `is_test: true`. Under the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is test-marked must be treated as a test-fixture and no structural refactor should be applied. Although both protocols share an identical field set (`makeMessage`, `makeNotification`, `name`), `MockNotificationMessage` exists to satisfy test-infrastructure needs and coupling it to the production `MainActorNotificationMessage` via a shared parent protocol would entangle production semantics with test semantics. The `_Plant_` prefix in the filename further signals this is a generated or deliberately isolated test double, reinforcing the restraint.
